reason: My evenings already work: same bar, same people, and anything big enough to matter shows up on Instagram stories or in our WhatsApp group anyway. Downloading an app to find things I would then have to go to alone is effort I will not spend.
objection: Nobody I know is on it, so even if I see a nice yoga session or a hike, I am not showing up by myself to a group of strangers.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three of my actual friends were already using it and I could see them marked as going to something, I would download it to follow along and probably buy a concert ticket through it eventually.
